faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about SoloTherapistAI.
faq.how1.q: How does the AI patient intake work?
faq.how1.a: When a prospective patient visits your intake link, they're guided through a warm, conversational intake experience. The AI gently asks about their presenting concerns, therapy history, what they're hoping to get from therapy, scheduling preferences, and insurance information. Patients respond naturally in their own words, and the system structures their answers into a clean intake summary delivered to your inbox.
faq.how2.q: What happens after a patient submits?
faq.how2.a: You receive a detailed email with contact info, presenting concerns, and AI-generated session prep notes (comorbidity flags, treatment history patterns, scheduling considerations) — visible only to you. The patient receives a warm confirmation email. All submissions are in your admin portal.
faq.how3.q: Does the AI provide therapy or counseling?
faq.how3.a: Absolutely not. The AI is strictly an intake tool — it collects information on your behalf in a warm, non-judgmental way. It never provides therapeutic advice, diagnoses, coping strategies, or crisis intervention. All clinical judgment remains entirely with you as the licensed professional.
faq.how4.q: What happens if a patient expresses suicidal thoughts or crisis?
faq.how4.a: The AI includes an automated safety detection feature. If it detects language indicating immediate risk of harm to self or others, it provides the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline number and Crisis Text Line information. This is an automated safety measure — it does not replace your clinical risk assessment protocols. You will also be notified immediately via your intake summary.
faq.how5.a: Yes. Full English and Spanish support. Patients select their preferred language at the start. The entire intake is delivered in their chosen language. Your notification emails are always in English.
faq.setup1.a: Most therapists are set up within 10 minutes. Enter your practice name, credentials, upload your logo, select therapeutic specializations, write a welcoming greeting, add custom intake questions, and connect your scheduling link.
faq.setup2.a: Anxiety, depression, trauma/PTSD, couples/marriage, family, grief/loss, addiction/substance abuse, ADHD, eating disorders, OCD, child/adolescent, LGBTQ+ affirming, anger management, life transitions, and more. You can add custom specializations.
faq.sec1.a: SoloTherapistAI is designed with HIPAA principles in mind — all data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest (AES-256), documents auto-delete after 30 days, no human reviews intake data, and the AI provider does not use your data for training. We recommend consulting with your compliance advisor to ensure it meets your specific requirements.
faq.sec2.q: Who can see my patients' intake submissions?
faq.sec2.a: Only you. Intake data is scoped strictly to your account. No data is shared across accounts. The AI-generated session prep notes are for your eyes only and never shared with the patient.
faq.billing1.q: Do you offer a free trial?
faq.billing1.a: Yes. 14-day free trial with full access. Credit card required but not charged until day 15.
faq.billing2.q: What is the difference between plans?
faq.billing2.a: Starter ($49/month) — 50 intakes, full intake system + Marketing Kit + 50 images/month + 5 blog posts/month. Pro ($79/month) — 150 intakes + 100 images/month + 10 blog posts/month + Document Intelligence. Pro+ ($119/month) — unlimited intakes + 150 images/month + 20 blog posts/month + AI phone line + soft limits.
faq.support1.q: Is this only for solo practitioners?
faq.support1.a: Built for solo therapists and small group practices. Each account is one therapist, one intake link, one inbox. Group practices can set up individual accounts per clinician.
